title: Number columns sort biggest first, then reversed, then first-load order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 50.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier B for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $150.00 by tier B, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer C, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $135.00 by Default, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers A, B and C in the Customer filter.
  3. Click the Parts Margin heading.
  4. Click the Parts Margin heading again.
  5. Click the Parts Margin heading a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Rows read Default, tier A, tier B (first-load order).

Step 3:

  • Rows read tier B ($150.00 − $100.00 = $50.00), Default ($35.00), tier A ($21.50).
  • An arrow shows on the Parts Margin heading, as in picture 20.13.

Step 4:

  • Rows read tier A ($21.50), Default ($35.00), tier B ($50.00).

Step 5:

  • Rows read Default, tier A, tier B again.
